nl.title: Hoe upgrade ik van 1 naar 2 AI-agents (Business → Extra Growth)?
nl.excerpt: Hoe upgrade ik van 1 naar 2 AI-agents (Business → Extra Growth): praktische handleiding in AI-agents, met stappen, controles en wanneer je TripleZero iT support inschakelt.
nl.bodyHtml:
Van Business (1 agent) naar Extra Growth (2 agents) upgrade je via de shop of support. Daarna volgt provisioning van het extra slot.

Upgrade-pad

  1. Kies Extra Growth in de shop of vraag een pakketwijziging aan.
  2. Rond betaling/bevestiging af.
  3. Controleer in /ai-agents of een tweede kaart verschijnt.
  4. Kies bewust het tweede type (zie combinatie-artikel).
  5. Start niet beide agents blind tijdens onderhoud.

Na de upgrade

  • Documenteer welke agent welk doel heeft.
  • Update je weekplanning.
  • Informeer teamleden die mee mogen starten/pauzeren.

Heb je na het volgen van deze stappen nog vragen? Neem contact op met TripleZero iT support via het ticketssysteem. Vermeld je pakketnaam, agenttype en status, zodat we sneller kunnen helpen.

Gerelateerd: Eerste agent in Business; duo in Extra Growth.

en.title: How do I upgrade I of 1 to 2 AI-agents (Business → extra Growth)?
en.excerpt: Plan/hosting in the client panel: check status, apply the change, confirm.
en.bodyHtml:
“How do I upgrade I of 1 to 2 AI-agents (Business → extra Growth)” is handled in the TripleZero iT client panel (products/invoices) or via support for migrations.

Preparation

  • Client panel login
  • Customer number/domain
  • Which change (upgrade/cancel/migration)

Steps

  1. Sign in to the TripleZero iT client panel.
  2. Open Products/Services or Invoices — depending on the request.
  3. For plan changes: choose upgrade/downgrade and confirm the order.
  4. For cancellation: follow Cancel and keep the confirmation.
  5. For migrations: open a ticket with DNS timeline and whether mail moves too.
  6. Check confirmation email and panel status.

Verify

  • Panel status or order confirmation is correct

Tip: Note the end date and whether domain is separate from hosting.

Note: No destructive deletes without an export.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: DNS, backups, tickets.
